OpenAI.// ChatCompletionsDeployment: Single source of truth for non-prod. Production overrides this via the literal OpenAI__ChatCompletionsDeployment app setting in infra/main.bicep. Must match a live deployment on po-aiservices-shared.

// ImageGen: Feature flag — switches the image-generation provider without a redeploy. 'google' = Gemini/Imagen; 'huggingface' = FLUX via HuggingFace Inference Providers (cheaper).
// HuggingFace: Set ApiKey (user-secrets/Key Vault) to a token with the 'Inference Providers' permission. Routes fal-native as {BaseUrl}/{Provider}/{providerId}. Defaults (FLUX schnell / Qwen-Image-Edit) are NON-GATED and verified live. Provider model ids come from https://huggingface.co/api/models/{repo}?expand[]=inferenceProviderMapping.

HuggingFace.// ChatModel: OpenAI-compatible chat model used by the Style Director reasoning agents ({BaseUrl}/v1/chat/completions). VisionModel must accept image inputs. Both must be enabled on your Inference-Providers token.

// AiPricing: Indicative USD list prices per 1024x1024 image, shown in the UI as estimates (not billed amounts). Keyed by ImageGen:Provider value.
